# Vendored: GetBody control bridge

`getbody_bridge.py` is an unmodified copy of GetBody's ready-made control bridge.
It handles the GetBody side of a body's connection (signing, reconnects,
heartbeats, invocation_id dedupe, kill and re-arm, and the local stand-in).
